plurals.item: Remove this attachment from its message on this device? The message, text and reactions will stay, with an attachment-removed marker.\n\nThis cannot be undone here. Copies on other devices, in other messages, in edit history and in existing backups are kept.

Remove these %1$d attachments from their messages on this device? The messages, text and reactions will stay, with attachment-removed markers.\n\nThis cannot be undone here. Copies on other devices, in other messages, in edit history and in existing backups are kept.
